art_direction:
Style:symbolic spiritual illustration, digital painting with soft luminous gradients
and glowing light, dreamlike meditative mood, rich jewel-tone color palette, atmospheric
background (stars / mist / aura). The described subject must be clearly rendered and
easily recognizable as itself — show its actual identifying shape and details; do not
reduce it to a generic glowing circle, ring, orb, or featureless blob. If a human
presence appears, render it ONLY as a small distant silhouette with no visible facial
or body detail, or as an abstract light-being with no anatomy — never a close-up
realistic body, never bare skin. Family-friendly, SFW. Aspect ratio 2:3 portrait.
No text, no logo, no watermark, no border/frame.

cards.title: 存在 Existence
cards.prompt: Abstract botanical illustration, no figure, no person, no human anatomy: a single glowing lotus-shaped flower made purely of starlight and soft mist petals, floating alone above a still dark cosmic ocean beneath a sky full of stars and a shooting comet. Deep indigo-to-violet gradient. Pure abstract light and floral form only, like a logo or icon.

cards.title: 內在之聲 Inner Voice
cards.prompt: Two silver-blue dolphins leaping and circling gracefully around a large glowing white crescent moon, spiral splashes of water below them, star-filled night sky. Cool blue-white palette, quiet inner listening.

cards.title: 創造力 Creativity
cards.prompt: A single glowing paintbrush, clearly visible with bristles and handle, mid-stroke, trailing vivid rainbow-colored ribbons of wet paint through the air in swirling curved shapes. Warm magenta-orange glow.

cards.title: 叛逆者 The Rebel

cards.title: 空無 No-Thingness

cards.title: 戀人 The Lovers

cards.title: 覺察 Awareness

cards.title: 勇氣 Courage

cards.title: 獨處 Aloneness

cards.title: 變化 Change

cards.title: 突破 Breakthrough

cards.title: 新視野 New Vision

cards.title: 蛻變 Transformation

cards.title: 整合 Integration

cards.title: 制約 Conditioning

cards.title: 雷電 Thunderbolt

cards.title: 超越幻象 Beyond Illusion

cards.title: 完成 Completion

cards.title: 參與 Participation

cards.title: 成功 Success

cards.title: 壓力 Stress

cards.title: 旅程 Traveling

cards.title: 壓抑 Suppression

cards.title: 玩心 Playfulness

cards.title: 熾烈 Intensity

cards.title: 分享 Sharing

cards.title: 創造者 The Creator

cards.title: 隨波逐流 Going With The Flow

cards.title: 知己之交 Friendliness
cards.prompt: Close-up of two tree trunks growing side by side, bark texture clearly visible, their upper branches visibly touching overhead. Empty forest, absolutely no people anywhere in the frame. Cool green-blue palette.

cards.title: 歡慶 Celebration
cards.prompt: Three ornate paper lanterns hanging from a branch, close-up filling most of the frame, swinging in wind and rain, warm light scattering through raindrops. No people anywhere. Lively blue-violet palette.

cards.title: 內觀 Turning In
cards.prompt: Abstract illustration, no figure, no person: a single still point of glowing light at the center of calm dark water, faint translucent geometric ripple-patterns drifting and dissolving outward like sonar waves, like a minimalist icon. Calm indigo palette.

cards.title: 放不下 Clinging To The Past
cards.prompt: Abstract object illustration, no figure, no person: an ornate antique wooden treasure trunk with a curved lid, glowing faintly from within with old sepia-toned memories, rusty chains and padlocks wrapped tightly around it, like a product photo of an object. Cool grey-blue tones, weight of longing for what has passed.

cards.title: 幻夢 The Dream

cards.title: 投射 Projections
cards.prompt: A pair of antique brass binoculars resting on a windowsill, each lens clearly reflecting a different colorful distorted scene. No people, no faces — just metal and glass. Ambiguous cool-toned mist.

cards.title: 放手 Letting Go
cards.prompt: A single water droplet sliding off a lotus leaf into calm water, gentle expanding ripples fading into stillness. Soft blue-grey palette, quiet release.

cards.title: 安逸 Laziness
cards.prompt: An empty lounge chair beside a half-finished drink, the mirror behind it quietly cracked. Cool blues with a subtle uneasy fracture of light, comfort mistaken for stillness.

cards.title: 和諧 Harmony
cards.prompt: Abstract illustration, no figure, no person, no human anatomy: two dolphins made of soft light swimming in a gentle figure-eight/infinity loop around each other, like a minimalist logo. Cool aqua-violet palette, inner balance.

cards.title: 理解 Understanding
cards.prompt: A bird flying freely past the loosely open bars of a cage, the bars rendered translucent and unlocked. Soft blue-white palette, realizing the limit was never solid.

cards.title: 信任 Trust
cards.prompt: A small bird diving fearlessly off a cliff edge into open sky above calm water, wings folded back, trusting the fall completely. No figure, no person. Warm light breaking through cool blue tones.

cards.title: 接納 Receptivity
cards.prompt: A pair of open cupped hands, disembodied and floating with no arms or body attached, gently holding a glowing blooming pink lotus flower between the palms. Soft starlight and water reflections around them. Cool blue-lavender palette.

cards.title: 療癒 Healing

cards.title: 意識之光 Consciousness
cards.prompt: A meditating silhouette made entirely of stars and soft mist against a deep midnight-blue sky. Quiet luminous clarity emerging from stillness.

cards.title: 拉鋸 Schizophrenia

cards.title: 封凍 Ice-olation

cards.title: 拖延 Postponement

cards.title: 比較 Comparison

cards.title: 重擔 The Burden

cards.title: 心機 Politics

cards.title: 自責 Guilt

cards.title: 悲傷 Sorrow
cards.prompt: A small hooded silhouette sitting in quiet contemplation, head bowed, a single thin beam of soft light breaking through darkness behind them. Deep blue-grey palette.

cards.title: 重生 Rebirth

cards.title: 紛亂之心 Mind

cards.title: 備戰 Fighting
cards.prompt: A suit of heavy armor standing alone, fists clenched empty inside, a small vulnerable glow barely visible through a crack in the chestplate. Cool steel-blue palette.

cards.title: 教條 Morality
cards.prompt: An empty rigid birdcage made of straight geometric metal bars, with several stiff formal shirt-collars stacked and hanging inside it like rungs. No person, no face inside. Muted grey-beige palette.

cards.title: 掌控 Control
cards.prompt: A glowing orb surrounded by sharp radiating spikes of self-made light, tightly contained. Cool blue-white palette with an undertone of strain.

cards.title: 圓熟 Maturity
cards.prompt: A blossoming tree standing serenely in soft spring light, its roots glowing deep and visible beneath the earth. Warm golden-green palette, earned stability.

cards.title: 當下 Moment To Moment

cards.title: 指引 Guidance
cards.prompt: A small luminous angel figure with large feathered rainbow-colored wings, clearly visible, hovering gently in the air beside a tiny glowing seed of light resting on the ground below. Warm prismatic glow.

cards.title: 守財者 The Miser
cards.prompt: A large glowing heap of gold coins and colorful gemstones piled in a dark shadowy corner, with two bony hands gripping a fistful of coins tightly, refusing to let go. Cool shadow despite the wealth around them.

cards.title: 局外人 The Outsider

cards.title: 妥協 Compromise

cards.title: 耐心 Patience

cards.title: 平凡 Ordinariness
cards.prompt: A small silhouette walking a simple country path carrying a basket of flowers, no audience. Warm soft earth-tone palette, quiet dignity in everyday simplicity.

cards.title: 熟成 Ripeness
cards.prompt: A single fully ripe fruit hanging heavy and glowing on a branch, about to fall on its own without force. Warm golden-orange palette, readiness.

cards.title: 世界一家 We Are The World
cards.prompt: Many small glowing figures of different colors, clearly distinct individuals, standing together in a large circle holding hands, forming an unbroken ring around a small glowing globe of the Earth at the center. Warm multicolor prismatic palette.

cards.title: 冒險 Adventure
cards.prompt: A small silhouette standing at the edge of a misty forest facing a glowing, uncertain rainbow-colored light ahead, no map. Warm-cool contrast, quiet courage.

cards.title: 放慢腳步 Slowing Down
cards.prompt: A large turtle, with clearly visible head, four legs and tail, carrying a glowing patterned shell on its back, walking slowly and calmly along a quiet forest path. Warm muted earth tones.

cards.title: 綻放 Flowering
cards.prompt: A fully blooming lotus radiating warm multicolor light and floating petals outward in every direction. Uninhibited open joy.

cards.title: 豐盛 Abundance
cards.prompt: A tree with roots deep in glowing earth and branches reaching into a glowing sky, warm full-bodied light connecting both. Harmony between physical enjoyment and inner depth.

cards.title: 卡背 Card Back
cards.prompt: An elegant symmetrical mandala-like pattern in deep indigo and gold, softly glowing at the center, no text, no figure, no person, abstract and mysterious geometric design.
